dcterms:description: CoRuSS is a corpus of Russian spontaneous speech that includes 30 hours of high-quality recordings from 60 native Russian speakers, with detailed prosodic annotation. It consists of dialogues, monologues, and readings of a phonetically balanced text.
dcterms:title: CoRuSS (Corpus of Russian Spontaneous Speech)
